_comment_schema: Every field here is required. The pipeline reads this to title the report and template the headline strings.
_comment_slug: Must match the directory name. Lowercase, hyphenated.
_comment_title: Goes on the cover. Be punchy.
title: The State of <Domain> Code
subtitle: A complete picture of <domain> code on GitHub.
_comment_audience_label: Used in '20,297 public repositories across 105 {audience_label}'. Plural.
_comment_entity_label: Used in 'the largest single {entity_label} repository is X'. Singular adjective.
_comment_hero_blurb: Cover-spread paragraph. 1-3 sentences. Sets the report's framing.
hero_blurb: We analysed every public repository across <describe the org set>. <Why this dataset matters in one sentence.> This is what we found.
